_comment: Wakil quickstart config for OpenRouter. Since 0.6.3 `wakil init` is the way to create a config; this file stays the single source of its default OpenRouter model (embedded into the binary) and is still fetched by install.sh before 0.6.3. The default model was chosen on 2026-11-09 from GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (no key needed) by this rule: ids ending in ':free' whose supported_parameters include 'tools', largest context_length first, then largest top_provider.max_completion_tokens, then id. A free model shows that Wakil runs, but it is weak at tool calling: for real work point 'model' at a paid model (for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6) or add your own endpoint. Reference with every option: config.example.json.
